verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into Garen's spin cooldowns without stacks; you win the moment you hold 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste on him.

brief.thesis: Lane trading itself is rated even, but Tahm Kench owns the kill threat: Q (Tongue Lash) builds stacks of An Acquired Taste on Garen, and at 3 stacks a 4th Q stuns him or R (Devour, 0s cooldown) removes him from the fight outright. That stack-and-remove combo is why Tahm sits at 56.6% over 286 games here despite even trades, and why OP.GG calls the matchup's shape aggressive.

theirWindow.what: Decisive Strike breaks all slows on him and silences you on hit, so don't commit your full stack combo into it — bait the 8s cooldown first or he cleanses your Tongue Lash slow and shuts down your follow-up.

yourWindow.when: You hold 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste
yourWindow.what: Land the 4th Tongue Lash for a free stun, or cast Devour (R, 0s cooldown) immediately to burst him with magic damage and pull him out of the fight before he can react.

start.why: Takes the measured 75.8% pick rate at 55.5% WR; the health regen and damage block absorb his E (Judgment) spin and auto trades while you build toward stacking Q.

boots.why: Measured 64.5% pick at 53.8% WR; flat physical damage reduction directly blunts Garen's auto-reliant Judgment and Decisive Strike trades.

core.why: Stacks raw HP, which scales both your passive (An Acquired Taste) auto damage and your overall tankiness in extended trades.
Core second item on the highest-sample build paths (35 and 21-game samples both route through it).
Highest-sample third item (65.7% WR, 35 games) for sustained damage once you're tanky enough to stay in extended fights.

runes.keystoneWhy: Procs on the autos you land between Q stacks, healing you and permanently growing your max health, which feeds back into your passive's bonus auto damage.

summoners.why: Highest pick rate in the data (62%) at 56% WR; Ignite closes out the kill window the stack-stun-Devour combo opens, converting your measured solo-kill advantage into actual kills.

playing.title: Stack Q before committing
playing.detail: Land Tongue Lash (Q, 7s cooldown at rank 1 scaling to 5s) repeatedly to build stacks of An Acquired Taste. At 3 stacks, a 4th Q stuns and consumes them, or cast Devour (R, 0s cooldown) for an instant magic-damage burst and removal.

playing.title: Bait Decisive Strike first
playing.detail: Garen's Q (Decisive Strike, 8s cooldown) breaks all slows on him and silences you on its next attack. Don't throw your stun-stack combo into an active Decisive Strike — wait for it to be down.

playing.title: Pre-shield his execute
playing.detail: Before Garen can threaten Demacian Justice (R, cooldown 140/110/80/50/20s), proactively trigger E (Thick Skin) to convert stored damage into a shield that blunts the execute, as OP.GG's own tip recommends.

playing.title: Poke to deny his passive
playing.detail: Garen's Perseverance regenerates a percentage of his max health per second if he hasn't recently taken damage. Keep landing Q on cooldown to keep that passive shut off.

playing.title: Use W to reposition, not just engage
playing.detail: Abyssal Dive (W, cooldown 21-17s, range 1000) damages and knocks up everything in the landing area — use it to reset a bad trade or follow a stack combo, not just as a flashy all-in opener.

playing.title: Swap Ignite for Teleport on long splits
playing.detail: Flash+Teleport runs at 50.7% WR and 16.4% pick; take it instead of Ignite if you expect a slower, wave-management-heavy lane rather than an early-kill lane.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoner spells, and all win rates are pulled from measured OP.GG games on the current patch; the stack-stun-Devour read on why Tahm wins the exchange despite even trading is our own tactical analysis.

stats.opponentTip: Use [Q] repeatedly to poke while using basic attacks when hit with his (Q) to stack up on [P] to use [W] to swallow him or [Q] to stun him. Try to use [E] beforehand when Garen tries to kill you using (R).
